messages:
liam: Quick check — vendor telemetry shows our spot pool in us-west2 hit ~20-30% preempt rate over the last 24h. We have a customer demo tomorrow morning. Any recommended soft-fallbacks or low-effort mitigations? Also finance asked we add an invoice note to the vendor PO. @maya @jonathan

maya: Yup, seeing similar. Preempt spikes cluster ~03:00-05:00 UTC. Options: (1) reserve 1-2 H100 standby for the demo (fast, costs more), (2) add a cross-region fallback to us-central for requests that time out, (3) reduce batch sizes and KV cache TTL to cut token spend on retries.

jonathan: Cross-region fallback is fine if demo latency tolerates ~30–40ms extra. We need a routing policy + a model-variant mapping in the config. I can do a tiny PR to wire it up. :+1:

sre-bot: deploy-bot: Canary routing policy applied to model `redwood-13b` in namespace `demo` at 2026-03-19T22:10Z — watchers: @eng-oncall

devex-ops: If finance needs an invoice note, suggest: `demo-standby: project:redwood-demo; approver:liam; window:48h`. Tess, can you confirm preferred wording/charge code?

tess: Tess (Finance): Confirm. Use charge code `RIDEMO-Q2`. Finance prefers a 48h note and a PO line referencing the demo. Please include PO number when you push the PR.

arjun: For a quick mitigation that doesn't change infra, we can set smaller batch size and bump KV cache TTL to avoid rebuilding context on fallback. Also add `max_tokens: 512` on heavy routes so a fallback costs less. Example snippet: ```yaml
inference:
  defaults:
    max_tokens: 512
    batch_size: 8
    kv_cache_ttl: 3600
```

maya: I opened the PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/compare/rt-fallback?expand=1 — pinging reviewers @jonathan @arjun. Includes routing policy + a simple `region_priority` map.

jonathan: Took a look, left one comment — prefer `region_priority` array over hard-coded fallback server so we can easily reorder. Otherwise LGTM.

liam: Thanks. I'll update the PO with finance note and the charge code, and run a smoke test in us-central at 15:30 PT. If anyone can hop on the call for the smoke test, please react with :eyes:

arjun: I'll stand by at 15:25 PT and watch metrics.

tess: Invoice note updated on our side and PO number added to the ticket. Please include PO# in the PR description.

sre-bot: incident-bot: No active incidents affecting us-west2 spot pools right now.
